first_paragraph: Tiny world model generates games and stream ac plays them all on Pico 2WUsing 2 small neural networks to generate and play the game at the same time on a Raspberry Pi Pico 2 W. The first one creates the game: given the current frame and the action, it predicts the next frame and the reward. Today, AI can generate lightweight, standalone, accessible HTML with just the CSS it needs, so a Minimal CSS Framework for Semantic HTML matters less than it used to. To stay relevant, Pico CSS would need a full rewrite: plain modern CSS instead of Sass, built on features it doesn't use today (OKLCH colors, cascade layers, Popover, anchor positioning) with fallbacks for older browsers, and a native compiler that strips unused CSS and makes customization easy. first_paragraph: CVE-2026-98432 is a use-after-free in the Linux kernel’s IPv4 TCP handshake path. The flaw appears when two processors act on related request and child sockets while both can still reference the same IP options object. One path may free that object immediately while another path, protected only as an RCU reader, continues to use it. The result is a stale kernel pointer in code reachable through network traffic.The concise description sounds like a familiar kernel race, but the public evidence demands careful interpretation. The CVE record carries a CVSS 3.1 score of 9.8, representing a network-reachable, unauthenticated worst case with high confidentiality, integrity, and availability impact. Red Hat’s product analysis assigns a lower 5.9 score because it treats exploitation as a difficult race and assesses the practical consequence in its supported products more conservatively. Compile an integer neural network into a DOOM map. Voodoo dolls do the arithmetic, light levels and plane heights hold the values, and every value is checked against NumPy with tolerance 0.

Doomformer compiles integer neural networks into ZDoom maps and runs them in ViZDoom. Voodoo dolls (the copies of the
player that DOOM spawns for extra player-1 starts) do the arithmetic, and sector light levels and plane heights hold the
sums. Python reads every exposed value back from the running game and compares it with a NumPy integer reference, tolerance 0.
One value off by one and the run fails. It is slow: about 23,000 times slower than NumPy on a small MLP (engine time; 65,000
times with a timer around the whole call), and a handwritten digit takes 163 seconds of real-time DOOM in one map at the
default schedule and 8 seconds at --opt 3.Install · Proof · How it works · Films · Docs

The racial slurs are critical as Twain used them to indict the culture of the antebellum American South, and not to endorse its prejudices.
